6:/-!
7:# The low-degree game
8:
9:The low-degree component of the Pauli basis test has finite question and answer
10:alphabets.  Its question maps act explicitly on the point, coordinate, and
11:direction registers of the ambient coefficient space and have recursive
12:conditionally linear representations of levels one, two, and three.
13:
14:## References
15:
16:The source-facing nodes are `def:ld-game`, `def:ld-question-distribution`, and
17:`def:ld-win-predicate` in
18:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`; their paper origin is
19:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
20:The exact decomposition of a scalar seed into its coordinate index and its
21:residue records the balance assertion for the map `chi` in the same source
22:definition.
23:-/
24:
25:open scoped BigOperators
26:
27:namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
28:
29:open MIPStarRE.LDT
30:
31:noncomputable section
32:
33:/-- Numerical parameters for the low-degree game.  The ambient coefficient
34:space uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq`, rather than a
35:model supplied by each parameter record.  This is the Lean carrier for
36:`def:ld-game` in
37:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, with paper origin
38:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
39:-/
40:structure LdParams where
41:  q : ℕ
42:  m : ℕ
43:  d : ℕ
44:  k : ℕ
45:  hm : 1 ≤ m
46:  hd : 1 ≤ d
47:  hk : 1 ≤ k
48:  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
49:  hdvd : m ∣ q
50:
51:/-- The positive dimension in `LdParams` supplies the finite coordinate type
52:used by the uniform axis and prefix-index marginals. -/
53:instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
54:  ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩
55:
56:/-- The fixed model accessor for an `LdParams` record.  It is a compatibility
57:view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently quantified
58:parameter.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
59:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
60:-/
61:noncomputable def LdParams.model (P : LdParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
62:  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
63:
64:/-- The scalar carrier selected by an `LdParams` record; this is the fixed
65:field carrier in `def:ld-game`, selected globally by `LdParams.model`.
66:Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
67:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
68:-/
69:abbrev ScalarQ (P : LdParams) := (P.model).K
70:
71:/-- The three low-degree question types of `def:ld-game`, blueprint
72:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
73:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
74:-/
75:inductive LdType where
76:  | point
77:  | aline
78:  | dline
79:  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
80:
81:/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
82:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
83:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
84:-/
85:abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
86:
87:/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
88:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
89:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
90:-/
91:abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
92:
93:/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
94:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
95:-/
96:def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
97:  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
98:
99:/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
100:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
101:-/
102:def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
103:  z (.inl (.inr ()) )
104:
105:/-- The direction coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
106:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
107:-/
108:def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
109:  fun i => z (.inr i)
110:
111:/-- The zero-based coordinate index corresponding to the paper's map `χ`:
112:`chiIndex P s` represents `χ(s) - 1` in the fixed field representation.  This
113:is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
114:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
115:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
116:-/
117:noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
118:  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
119:    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
120:  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
121:
122:/-! ### Formalization-only coordinate-index fibers
123:
124:The following decomposition supplies the equal-fiber calculation used in the
125:uniform coordinate-index law.
126:-/
127:
128:/-- The common residue set in a fiber of `chiIndex` is nonempty.  This is part
129:of the exact seed decomposition supporting the balance assertion in
130:`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `lem:chi-seed-fibers`, paper
131:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
132:-/
133:theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
134:  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
135:    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
136:    rw [hq]
137:    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
138:
139:/-- Divisibility identifies the scalar cardinality with the product of the
140:coordinate-index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality.  This supports
141:`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
142:theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
143:    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
144:  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm
145:
146:/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
147:natural-number representative. -/
148:@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
149:    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by
150:  subst n
151:  rfl
152:
153:/-- A scalar seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its
154:`chiIndex` fiber.  This is the exact decomposition underlying
155:`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
156:noncomputable def seedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
157:    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=
158:  (binaryRepresentation L.model).trans <|
159:    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans
160:      finProdFinEquiv.symm
161:
162:/-- The coordinate component of the exact seed decomposition is `chiIndex`. -/
163:@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_fst (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) :
164:    (seedFiberEquiv L s).1 = chiIndex L s := by
165:  letI : NeZero L.m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm)⟩
166:  have hquot : (binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
167:    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul L.seedFiberCard_pos).mpr
168:    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd]
169:    exact (binaryRepresentation L.model s).isLt
170:  simp only [seedFiberEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
171:  apply Fin.ext
172:  change
173:    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq)
174:      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
175:      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val
176:  rw [equivCastFin_val]
177:  · exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hquot).symm
178:  · exact L.seedFiberProduct_eq
179:
180:/-- Reconstruct the scalar seed belonging to a coordinate and its fiber
181:residue. -/
182:noncomputable def seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
183:    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ScalarQ L :=
184:  (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (i, r)
185:
186:/-- Decomposing a reconstructed seed recovers its coordinate and residue. -/
187:@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
188:    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
189:    seedFiberEquiv L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = (i, r) :=
190:  (seedFiberEquiv L).apply_symm_apply (i, r)
191:
192:/-- A reconstructed seed belongs to the prescribed `chiIndex` fiber. -/
193:@[simp] theorem chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
194:    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
195:    chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = i := by
196:  rw [← seedFiberEquiv_fst]
197:  simp
198:
199:/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
200:chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the
201:prefix restriction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
202:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
203:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
204:-/
205:def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
206:    Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
207:  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
208:
209:/-- Zeroing the coordinates preceding a fixed index is idempotent.  This is a
210:formalization-only consequence of the prefix restriction in
211:`def:ld-question-distribution`, recorded as `lem:prefix-projection-idempotent`
212:in blueprint chapter 13. -/
213:theorem prefixProjection_idempotent {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m)
214:    (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
215:    prefixProjection i (prefixProjection i v) = prefixProjection i v := by
216:  funext j
217:  by_cases h : j.val < i.val
218:  · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h]
219:  · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
220:
221:/-- The point CL map, retaining the point block and clearing the auxiliary
222:blocks.  It is the map `L_point` of `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
223:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
224:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
225:-/
226:def ldPointCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
227:  fun i => match i with
228:  | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
229:  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
230:  | .inr _ => 0
231:
232:/-- The affine-line CL map.  The direction block is put through the canonical
233:line representative map from `def:line-representative`, while the point block
234:is retained (blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper
235:origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
236:-/
237:noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
238:  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
239:  let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
240:  fun i => match i with
241:  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
242:  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
243:  | .inr _ => 0
244:
245:/-- The diagonal-line CL map, using the same canonical representative interface
246:for the direction block.  This is the `L_DLine` clause of
247:`def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
248:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper origin
249:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
250:-/
251:noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
252:  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
253:  let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
254:  let rep := lineRepMap direction
255:  fun i => match i with
256:  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
257:  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
258:  | .inr j => direction j
259:
260:/-- Dispatch the three low-degree CL maps by question type.  This is the typed
261:construction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
262:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
263:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
264:-/
265:noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
266:  | .point => ldPointCL P
267:  | .aline => ldALineCL P
268:  | .dline => ldDLineCL P
269:
270:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the shared scalar
271:coordinate of the ambient low-degree space.  It is the first register in the
272:concatenation exhibiting the conditional-linearity levels asserted in
273:`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
274:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
275:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
276:private def ldSeedRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
277:  {Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())}
278:
279:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the point coordinates
280:of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
281:private def ldPointRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
282:  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P)
283:
284:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the direction
285:coordinates of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
286:private def ldDirectionRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
287:  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P)
288:
289:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map retaining the shared scalar
290:coordinate and clearing every other coordinate. -/
291:private def ldSeedLinear (P : LdParams) :
292:    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
293:  toFun x := fun i =>
294:    match i with
295:    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
296:    | .inl (.inr _) => x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
297:    | .inr _ => 0
298:  map_add' x y := by
299:    funext i
300:    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
301:  map_smul' c x := by
302:    funext i
303:    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
304:
305:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map sending the point block to its
306:canonical line representative in the fixed direction `v` and clearing every
307:other coordinate. -/
308:private noncomputable def ldPointCLLinear (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
309:    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
310:  toFun x := fun i =>
311:    match i with
312:    | .inl (.inl j) => lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point x) j
313:    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
314:    | .inr _ => 0
315:  map_add' x y := by
316:    funext i
317:    rcases i with (j | u) | j
318:    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (x + y)) j = _
319:      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (x + y) = LdSpace.point x + LdSpace.point y := rfl
320:      rw [hpoint, map_add]
321:      rfl
322:    · simp
323:    · simp
324:  map_smul' c x := by
325:    funext i
326:    rcases i with (j | u) | j
327:    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (c • x)) j = _
328:      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (c • x) = c • LdSpace.point x := rfl
329:      rw [hpoint, map_smul]
330:      rfl
331:    · simp
332:    · simp
333:
334:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map zeroing the first `i`
335:coordinates of the direction block and clearing every other coordinate. -/
336:private def ldDirectionCLLinear (P : LdParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
337:    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
338:  toFun x := fun k =>
339:    match k with
340:    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
341:    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
342:    | .inr j => prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
343:  map_add' x y := by
344:    funext k
345:    rcases k with (j | u) | j
346:    · simp
347:    · simp
348:    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (x + y)) j =
349:        prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j +
350:          prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction y) j
351:      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
352:      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, add_zero]
353:      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
354:        rfl
355:  map_smul' c x := by
356:    funext k
357:    rcases k with (j | u) | j
358:    · simp
359:    · simp
360:    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (c • x)) j =
361:        c • prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
362:      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
363:      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, smul_zero]
364:      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
365:        rfl
366:
367:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the shared-scalar map vanishes
368:outside the scalar register. -/
369:private theorem ldSeedLinear_supported (P : LdParams) :
370:    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldSeedRegister P →
371:      ldSeedLinear P x i = 0 := by
372:  intro x i hi
373:  rcases i with (j | u) | j
374:  · rfl
375:  · cases u
376:    exact absurd (Finset.mem_singleton_self _) hi
377:  · rfl
378:
379:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the canonical-representative map
380:vanishes outside the point register. -/
381:private theorem ldPointCLLinear_supported (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
382:    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldPointRegister P →
383:      ldPointCLLinear P v x i = 0 := by
384:  intro x i hi
385:  rcases i with (j | u) | j
386:  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hi
387:  · rfl
388:  · rfl
389:
390:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the prefix-zeroing map vanishes
391:outside the direction register. -/
392:private theorem ldDirectionCLLinear_supported (P : LdParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
393:    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (k : LdIndex P), k ∉ ldDirectionRegister P →
394:      ldDirectionCLLinear P i x k = 0 := by
395:  intro x k hk
396:  rcases k with (j | u) | j
397:  · rfl
398:  · rfl
399:  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hk
400:
401:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the point register is disjoint from
402:the scalar register. -/
403:private theorem ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed (P : LdParams) :
404:    ldPointRegister P ⊆ Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P := by
405:  intro i hi
406:  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
407:  simp [ldSeedRegister]
408:
409:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the direction register is disjoint
410:from the scalar register. -/
411:private theorem ldDirectionRegister_subset_sdiff_seed (P : LdParams) :
412:    ldDirectionRegister P ⊆ Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P := by
413:  intro i hi
414:  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
415:  simp [ldSeedRegister]
416:
417:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the point register is disjoint from
418:both the scalar and the direction registers. -/
419:private theorem ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed_direction (P : LdParams) :
420:    ldPointRegister P ⊆
421:      (Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P) \ ldDirectionRegister P := by
422:  intro i hi
423:  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
424:  simp [ldSeedRegister, ldDirectionRegister]
425:
426:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the scalar register
427:leaves the shared scalar coordinate unchanged. -/
428:private theorem coordinateRestriction_seed (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
429:    coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) =
430:      x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) := by
431:  have hmem : (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()) : LdIndex P) ∈ ldSeedRegister P :=
432:    Finset.mem_singleton_self _
433:  simp [coordinateRestriction, hmem]
434:
435:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the point register
436:leaves the point block unchanged. -/
437:private theorem coordinateRestriction_point (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
438:    LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) = LdSpace.point x := by
439:  funext j
440:  have hmem : (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P) ∈ ldPointRegister P :=
441:    Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
442:  simp [LdSpace.point, coordinateRestriction, hmem]
443:
444:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the direction register
445:leaves the direction block unchanged. -/
446:private theorem coordinateRestriction_direction (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
447:    LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) =
448:      LdSpace.direction x := by
449:  funext j
450:  have hmem : (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P) ∈ ldDirectionRegister P :=
451:    Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
452:  simp [LdSpace.direction, coordinateRestriction, hmem]
453:
454:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a two-level representation of the
455:affine-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
456:private noncomputable def ldALineTerm (P : LdParams) :
457:    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 2 :=
458:  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
459:    fun y =>
460:      .succ (ldPointRegister P)
461:        (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y))))
462:        (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
463:        fun _ => .zero
464:
465:/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a three-level representation of the
466:diagonal-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
467:private noncomputable def ldDLineTerm (P : LdParams) :
468:    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 3 :=
469:  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
470:    fun y =>
471:      .succ (ldDirectionRegister P)
472:        (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y)))
473:        (ldDirectionCLLinear_supported P _)
474:        fun w =>
475:          .succ (ldPointRegister P)
476:            (ldPointCLLinear P (LdSpace.direction w))
477:            (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
478:            fun _ => .zero
479:
480:/-- The conditional-linearity level of the affine-line map.  This is
481:`lem:ld-aline-level`, the level-2 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
482:blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:61-71`, paper
483:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
484:-/
485:theorem isCondLinear_ldALineCL (P : LdParams) :
486:    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 2 (ldALineCL P) := by
487:  refine ⟨ldALineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
488:    ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩, ?_⟩
489:  funext x
490:  have hseed :
491:      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
492:        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
493:  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
494:      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
495:  have hval :
496:      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldALineTerm P) x =
497:        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
498:          (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
499:            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) := by
500:    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
501:        (ldPointCLLinear P
502:            (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P
503:              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)))))
504:            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) = _
505:    rw [hseed]
506:  rw [hval]
507:  funext i
508:  rcases i with (j | u) | j
509:  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) +
510:        (lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
511:          (LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x)) j + 0) =
512:      lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
513:        (LdSpace.point x) j
514:    rw [hpoint, zero_add, add_zero]
515:  · change coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) +
516:        ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
517:    rw [coordinateRestriction_seed, add_zero, add_zero]
518:  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = 0
519:    rw [add_zero, add_zero]
520:
521:/-- The conditional-linearity level of the diagonal-line map.  This is
522:`lem:ld-dline-level`, the level-3 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
523:blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:73-83`, paper origin
524:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
525:-/
526:theorem isCondLinear_ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) :
527:    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 3 (ldDLineCL P) := by
528:  refine ⟨ldDLineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
529:    ⟨ldDirectionRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ =>
530:      ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed_direction P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩⟩, ?_⟩
531:  funext x
532:  have hseed :
533:      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
534:        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
535:  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
536:      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
537:  have hdir :
538:      LdSpace.direction
539:          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
540:            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) =
541:        prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x) := by
542:    funext j
543:    change prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
544:        (LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) j = _
545:    rw [coordinateRestriction_direction]
546:  have hval :
547:      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldDLineTerm P) x =
548:        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
549:          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
550:              (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
551:            (ldPointCLLinear P
552:                (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
553:                (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) := by
554:    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
555:        (ldDirectionCLLinear P
556:            (chiIndex P
557:              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
558:            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
559:          (ldPointCLLinear P
560:              (LdSpace.direction
561:                (ldDirectionCLLinear P
562:                  (chiIndex P
563:                    (LdSpace.seed
564:                      (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
565:                  (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)))
566:              (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) = _
567:    rw [hseed, hdir]
568:  rw [hval]
569:  funext i
570:  rcases i with (j | u) | j
571:  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) +
572:        (lineRepMap
573:          (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
574:          (LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x)) j + 0)) =
575:      lineRepMap (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
576:        (LdSpace.point x) j
577:    rw [hpoint, zero_add, zero_add, add_zero]
578:  · change coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) +
579:        ((0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0)) = x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
580:    rw [coordinateRestriction_seed, add_zero, add_zero, add_zero]
581:  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) +
582:        (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
583:            (LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) j +
584:          ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0)) =
585:      prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x) j
586:    rw [coordinateRestriction_direction, zero_add, add_zero, add_zero]
587:
588:/-- The question alphabet for the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
589:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
590:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
591:-/
592:abbrev LdQuestion (P : LdParams) := LdType × LdSpace P
593:
594:/-- The typed CL question distribution.  This is the inlined construction in
595:`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper
596:origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
597:-/
598:noncomputable def ldQuestionDistribution (P : LdParams) :
599:    Distribution (LdQuestion P × LdQuestion P) :=
600:  Distribution.map
601:    (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P))
602:    (fun s =>
603:      ((s.1.1, ldCL P s.1.1 s.2), (s.1.2, ldCL P s.1.2 s.2)))
604:
605:/-- The coefficient-tuple answer alphabet of the low-degree game.  Polynomial
606:answers are representatives with exactly the coefficient lengths printed in
607:the paper, as required by `def:ld-win-predicate` (blueprint
608:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`; paper
609:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
610:-/
611:inductive LdAnswer (P : LdParams) where
612:  | pointVals (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P)
613:  | alinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
614:  | dlinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
615:  deriving DecidableEq
616:
617:/-- A finite sum code used only to provide the answer alphabet's `Fintype`
618:instance; the public constructors are those of `def:ld-win-predicate`,
619:blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
620:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
621:-/
622:abbrev LdAnswerCode (P : LdParams) :=
623:  (Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) ⊕
624:    ((Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P) ⊕
625:      (Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P))
626:
627:/-- The constructor-preserving code equivalence for `LdAnswer` (Lean-only
628:finite-carrier infrastructure for `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
629:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
630:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
631:-/
632:noncomputable def ldAnswerEquiv (P : LdParams) :
633:    LdAnswer P ≃ LdAnswerCode P where
634:  toFun
635:    | .pointVals a => .inl a
636:    | .alinePolys a => .inr (.inl a)
637:    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)
638:  invFun
639:    | .inl a => .pointVals a
640:    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePolys a
641:    | .inr (.inr a) => .dlinePolys a
642:  left_inv := by intro x; cases x <;> rfl
643:  right_inv := by
644:    intro x
645:    cases x with
646:    | inl a => rfl
647:    | inr x =>
648:        cases x with
649:        | inl a => rfl
650:        | inr a => rfl
651:
652:instance (P : LdParams) : Inhabited (LdAnswer P) :=
653:  ⟨.pointVals (fun _ => 0)⟩
654:
655:noncomputable instance (P : LdParams) : Fintype (LdAnswer P) :=
656:  Fintype.ofEquiv (LdAnswerCode P) (ldAnswerEquiv P).symm
657:
658:/-- Evaluation of a coefficient tuple at a field element.  This is the
659:representative convention used by the line answers in `def:ld-win-predicate`,
660:blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
661:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
662:-/
663:def evalCoefficient {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {n : ℕ}
664:    (c : Fin n → K) (t : K) : K :=
665:  ∑ i : Fin n, c i * t ^ i.val
666:
667:/-- Check that an answer has the constructor prescribed by its question type;
668:Lean encoding of the rejection clause in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
669:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
670:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
671:-/
672:def validLdAnswer {P : LdParams} (t : LdType) (a : LdAnswer P) : Bool :=
673:  match t, a with
674:  | .point, .pointVals _ => true
675:  | .aline, .alinePolys _ => true
676:  | .dline, .dlinePolys _ => true
677:  | _, _ => false
678:
679:/-- The axis-parallel line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
680:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
681:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
682:-/
683:def alinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
684:    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
685:    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
686:  -- Universal quantification follows the zero-direction convention in
687:  -- `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
688:  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
689:    point.point = line.point + t • coordinateDirection (chiIndex P line.seed) →
690:      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
691:
692:/-- The diagonal line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
693:`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
694:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
695:-/
696:def dlinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
697:    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
698:    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
699:  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
700:    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
701:      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
702:
703:/-- The low-degree consistency predicate, rejecting answers of the wrong
704:constructor shape.  This is `def:ld-win-predicate` in
705:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
706:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
707:-/
708:noncomputable def ldWinPredicate (P : LdParams) :
709:    LdQuestion P → LdQuestion P → LdAnswer P → LdAnswer P → Bool :=
710:  open Classical in
711:  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
712:      if validLdAnswer tA a && validLdAnswer tB b then
713:        match tA, tB, a, b with
714:        | .point, .point, .pointVals u, .pointVals v => decide (u = v)
715:        | .aline, .point, .alinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
716:            decide (alinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
717:        | .point, .aline, .pointVals u, .alinePolys f =>
718:            decide (alinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
719:        | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
720:            decide (dlinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
721:        | .point, .dline, .pointVals u, .dlinePolys f =>
722:            decide (dlinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
723:        | .aline, .aline, .alinePolys f, .alinePolys g => decide (f = g)
724:        | .dline, .dline, .dlinePolys f, .dlinePolys g => decide (f = g)
725:        | _, _, _, _ => true
726:      else false
727:
728:/-- The low-degree game packaged as a `Game`.  This is `def:ld-game` in
729:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, paper origin
730:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
731:-/
732:noncomputable def ldGame (P : LdParams) : Game where
733:  QuestionA := LdQuestion P
734:  QuestionB := LdQuestion P
735:  AnswerA := LdAnswer P
736:  AnswerB := LdAnswer P
737:  μ := ldQuestionDistribution P
738:  μ_prob := by
739:    exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
740:      (uniformDistribution_isProbability ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P)) _
741:  decide := ldWinPredicate P
742:
743:end
744:
745:end MIPStarRE.QPBT

5:# Main-formal soundness theorem

7:This module contains the corrected two-space final theorem for
8:`thm:main-formal`.  The theorem starts from a general projective strategy
9:`ProjStrat params ιA ιB`, applies the heterogeneous role-register route, and
10:absorbs the explicit intermediate errors into the final parameter
11:`mainFormalError`.

14:the nonzero sampling condition `0 < k`.  These are documented in
15:`docs/paper-gaps/issue-906-main-formal-k-bound.tex` and
16:`docs/paper-gaps/issue-422-main-formal-zero-k-boundary.tex`.

21:  `thm:main-formal` at line 180; its proof is in
22:  `references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex` (lines 26–236).
23:* Blueprint: `blueprint/src/chapter/ch02_test.tex`,
24:  `\label{thm:main-formal}`.

36:Trivial saturated-error branch for the printed two-space theorem
37:`thm:main-formal`.
38:
39:Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`.
40:
41:**Source:** This is a source-faithful saturated-error branch: when the printed
42:target error is at least `1`, the consistency conclusion follows from the
43:normalization bound for bipartite consistency defects, without adding any
44:construction hypothesis to the source theorem.
45:
46:Whenever `mainFormalError params k eps ≥ 1`, the three consistency conclusions
47:hold for arbitrary projective polynomial measurements, since each underlying
48:consistency defect is bounded by `1` for a normalized bipartite state and a
49:uniform question distribution.  The argument does not use the low individual
50:degree test hypothesis. -/
51:theorem mainFormal_trivial_witness
52:    (params : Parameters)
53:    [FieldModel params.q]
54:    {ιA ιB : Type*}
55:    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
56:    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
57:    (strategy : ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
58:    (eps : Error)
59:    (k : ℕ)
60:    (herr : 1 ≤ mainFormalError params k eps) :
61:    ∃ G_A : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιA,
62:      ∃ G_B : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιB,
63:        ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
64:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
65:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
66:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
67:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
68:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
69:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
70:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
71:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution Unit)
72:            (constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
73:            (constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
74:            (mainFormalError params k eps) := by
75:  classical
76:  haveI : Inhabited (Polynomial params) :=
77:    ⟨⟨0, by intro i; simp [MvPolynomial.degreeOf_zero]⟩⟩
78:  let trivialA : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιA :=
79:    ProjMeas.trivialDistinguishedOutcome (default : Polynomial params)
80:  let trivialB : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιB :=
81:    ProjMeas.trivialDistinguishedOutcome (default : Polynomial params)
82:  refine ⟨trivialA, trivialB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
83:  all_goals exact ⟨le_trans
84:    (bipartiteConsError_uniform_le_one strategy.state strategy.isNormalized _ _) herr⟩
85:
86:/-- Source role-register conclusion after the scalar branch has supplied
87:`0 < k`.
88:
89:This theorem is not an additional hypothesis of `thm:main-formal`; it isolates
90:the checked two-space role-register construction from the scalar absorption at
91:the corrected nonzero sampling boundary.  The proof uses
92:`ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterFinalPointConsistency` and then weakens the three
93:explicit pre-absorption errors to `mainFormalError` by the existing Step 8
94:scalar cascade. -/
95:theorem mainFormalConclusion_ofRoleRegisterScalarBoundary
96:    (params : Parameters)
97:    [FieldModel params.q]
98:    {ιA ιB : Type*}
99:    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
100:    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
101:    (strategy : ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
102:    (eps : Error)
103:    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
104:    (k : ℕ)
105:    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k)
106:    (hk0 : 0 < k)
107:    (hsmall : ¬ 1 ≤ mainFormalError params k eps) :
108:    ∃ G_A : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιA,
109:      ∃ G_B : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιB,
110:        ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
111:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
112:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
113:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
114:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
115:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
116:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
117:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
118:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution Unit)
119:            (constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
120:            (constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
121:            (mainFormalError params k eps) := by
122:  classical
123:  have hepsNN : 0 ≤ eps := ProjStrat.eps_nonneg_of_passes hpass
124:  let scalars : MainFormalScalarBounds params eps k :=
125:    MainFormalScalarBounds.ofNontrivialMainFormal hepsNN hk0 hsmall
126:  let σsrc : Error :=
127:    2 * MainInductionStep.mainInductionError params k (3 * eps) (3 * eps) (3 * eps)
128:  let ζ₁src : Error :=
129:    σsrc + 2 * Real.sqrt (3 * eps + σsrc) + (params.m * params.d : Error) / params.q
130:  let ζ₂src : Error := MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ₁src
131:  let ηsrc : Error :=
132:    ζ₁src + Real.sqrt (MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError ζ₁src)
133:  let ζ₃src : Error := 6 * ζ₁src + 6 * ζ₂src
134:  have hσsrc : σsrc = 2 * scalars.sigma := by
135:    simp [σsrc, MainFormalScalarBounds.sigma, mainFormalScalarSigma_eq_mainInductionError]
136:  have hζ₁src : ζ₁src = scalars.zeta1 := by
137:    simp [ζ₁src, σsrc, MainFormalScalarBounds.zeta1, cascadeZeta1,
138:      MainFormalScalarBounds.sigma, mainFormalScalarSigma_eq_mainInductionError]
139:  have hζ₂src : ζ₂src ≤ scalars.zeta2 := by
140:    change MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError ζ₁src ≤ scalars.zeta2
141:    rw [hζ₁src]
142:    exact MainFormalScalarBounds.orthonormalizeAndCompleteError_zeta1_le_zeta2
143:      scalars hsmall
144:  have hηsrc : ηsrc = scalars.line169Error := by
145:    have hζ0 : 0 ≤ scalars.zeta1 := MainFormalScalarBounds.zeta1_nonneg scalars
146:    have hsqrt :
147:        Real.sqrt (MakingMeasurementsProjective.orthonormalizationError scalars.zeta1) =
148:          10 * Real.rpow scalars.zeta1 (1 / (8 : Error)) :=
149:      MakingMeasurementsProjective.sqrt_orthonormalizationError_eq hζ0
150:    simp [ηsrc, hζ₁src, MainFormalScalarBounds.line169Error,
151:      cascadeLine169RepairError, hsqrt]
152:  have hζ₃src : ζ₃src ≤ scalars.zeta3 := by
153:    have hζ₁le : ζ₁src ≤ scalars.zeta1 := le_of_eq hζ₁src
154:    have hcore : 6 * ζ₁src + 6 * ζ₂src ≤ 6 * scalars.zeta1 + 6 * scalars.zeta2 := by
155:      nlinarith
156:    simpa [ζ₃src, MainFormalScalarBounds.zeta3, cascadeZeta3] using hcore
157:  have hsourcePoint :
158:      σsrc + 2 * Real.sqrt (ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2) ≤ mainFormalError params k eps := by
159:    have hrad :
160:        ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2 ≤ scalars.line169Error + scalars.zeta3 / 2 := by
161:      have hηle : ηsrc ≤ scalars.line169Error := le_of_eq hηsrc
162:      nlinarith
163:    have hsqrt :
164:        Real.sqrt (ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2) ≤
165:          Real.sqrt (scalars.line169Error + scalars.zeta3 / 2) :=
166:      Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hrad
167:    have hrepaired :
168:        σsrc + 2 * Real.sqrt (ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2) ≤ scalars.zeta4Repaired := by
169:      calc
170:        σsrc + 2 * Real.sqrt (ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2)
171:            = 2 * scalars.sigma + 2 * Real.sqrt (ηsrc + ζ₃src / 2) := by
172:              rw [hσsrc]
173:        _ ≤ 2 * scalars.sigma + 2 *
174:              Real.sqrt (scalars.line169Error + scalars.zeta3 / 2) := by
175:            nlinarith
176:        _ = scalars.zeta4Repaired := by
177:            rfl
178:    exact hrepaired.trans (MainFormalScalarBounds.zeta4Repaired_le_mainFormalError scalars)
179:  have hsourceSelf :
180:      ζ₃src / 2 ≤ mainFormalError params k eps := by
181:    have htoCascade : ζ₃src / 2 ≤ scalars.zeta3 / 2 := by
182:      nlinarith
183:    exact htoCascade.trans (MainFormalScalarBounds.zeta3_div_two_le_mainFormalError scalars)
184:  rcases ProjStrat.sourceRoleRegisterFinalPointConsistency
185:      params strategy eps hpass k hk with ⟨Q_A, Q_B, hA, hrest⟩
186:  rcases hrest with ⟨hB, hrest⟩
187:  rcases hrest with ⟨_hQQEval, hQQ⟩
188:  refine ⟨Q_A, Q_B, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
189:  · exact ConsRel.mono (by
190:      simpa [σsrc, ζ₁src, ζ₂src, ηsrc, ζ₃src] using hsourcePoint) hA
191:  · exact ConsRel.mono (by
192:      simpa [σsrc, ζ₁src, ζ₂src, ηsrc, ζ₃src] using hsourcePoint) hB
193:  · exact ConsRel.mono (by
194:      simpa [σsrc, ζ₁src, ζ₂src, ηsrc, ζ₃src] using hsourceSelf) hQQ
195:

258:theorem mainFormalConclusion
259:    (params : Parameters)

261:    {ιA ιB : Type*}

263:    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
264:    (strategy : ProjStrat params ιA ιB)

266:    (hpass : strategy.PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest eps)
267:    (k : ℕ)

269:    (hk0 : 0 < k) :
270:    ∃ G_A : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιA,
271:      ∃ G_B : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιB,

274:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)

291:Paper origin: `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`.
292:
293:This theorem records the two-space source theorem with the confirmed large-`k`
294:correction `k ≥ 400 m d`.  The paper prints the weaker hypothesis `k ≥ m d`;
295:the missing factor `400` is documented in

298:to zero; this boundary is documented in

300:theorem mainFormal
301:    (params : Parameters)

303:    {ιA ιB : Type*}
304:    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA]
305:    [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
306:    (strategy : ProjStrat params ιA ιB)
307:    (eps : Error)
308:    (hpass : strategy.lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤ eps)
309:    (k : ℕ)
310:    (hk : 400 * params.m * params.d ≤ k)
311:    (hk0 : 0 < k) :
312:    ∃ G_A : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιA,
313:      ∃ G_B : ProjMeas (Polynomial params) ιB,
314:        ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
315:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementA)
316:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_B.toSubMeas)
317:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
318:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution (Point params))
319:            (polynomialEvaluationFamily params G_A.toSubMeas)
320:            (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurementB)
321:            (mainFormalError params k eps) ∧
322:          ConsRel strategy.state (uniformDistribution Unit)
323:            (constSubMeasFamily G_A.toSubMeas)
324:            (constSubMeasFamily G_B.toSubMeas)
325:            (mainFormalError params k eps) := by

5:/-!
6:# Geometry for the directly indexed low-degree game
7:
8:This module defines the parameters, line carrier, and line-point distributions
9:for the directly indexed low-degree game.
10:
11:## References
12:
13:The line-point distributions originate in
14:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`.
15:The directly indexed repair is documented in
16:`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
17:-/
18:
19:open scoped BigOperators
20:
21:namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
22:
23:open MIPStarRE.LDT
24:open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
25:open MIPStarRE.Quantum

27:noncomputable section
28:
29:/-- Parameters for the directly indexed low-degree game.  Unlike `LdParams`,
30:this directly indexed line-space construction has no divisibility field: its coordinate index is
31:sampled from `Fin m` rather than encoded by fibers of `chiIndex`.
32:
33:This is the direct-index repair described in
34:`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`; it is not a second
35:definition of the source verifier game. -/
36:structure DirectLdParams where
37:  q : ℕ
38:  m : ℕ
39:  d : ℕ
40:  k : ℕ
41:  hm : 1 ≤ m
42:  hd : 1 ≤ d
43:  hk : 1 ≤ k
44:  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
45:
46:/-- The canonical scalar model for directly indexed parameters. -/
47:noncomputable def DirectLdParams.model (D : DirectLdParams) : FixedFieldModel D.q :=
48:  fixedFieldModel D.q D.hq
49:
50:/-- The scalar field of a directly indexed low-degree game. -/
51:abbrev DirectScalarQ (D : DirectLdParams) := D.model.K
52:
53:/-- The first coordinate, available because directly indexed dimensions are
54:positive. -/
55:def DirectLdParams.firstIndex (D : DirectLdParams) : Fin D.m :=
56:  ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm⟩
57:
58:instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Nonempty (Fin D.m) := ⟨D.firstIndex⟩
59:
60:/-- The direct game used at the extended dimension of the combining map.  Its
61:field, degree, and simultaneity parameters are inherited from `P`, while its
62:dimension is `2 * P.m + 2`; no divisibility assertion is introduced.
63:
64:The construction has dimension `2 * P.m + 2` without requiring
65:`2 * P.m + 2 ∣ P.q`; it supplies the directly indexed line and coordinate
66:spaces used in the dimension-extension argument of
67:`blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1257-1293`.
68:-/
69:def AdmissibleParams.extendedDirectLd (P : AdmissibleParams) : DirectLdParams where
70:  q := P.q
71:  m := 2 * P.m + 2
72:  d := P.d
73:  k := 1
74:  hm := by omega
75:  hd := P.hd
76:  hk := by decide
77:  hq := P.hq
78:
79:/-- A common random sample for the directly indexed question distribution.
80:The point, coordinate index, and unrestricted direction are mutually uniform. -/
81:structure DirectLdSpace (D : DirectLdParams) where
82:  point : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
83:  index : Fin D.m
84:  direction : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
85:  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
86:
87:instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Nonempty (DirectLdSpace D) :=
88:  ⟨⟨0, D.firstIndex, 0⟩⟩
89:
90:/-- Decompose a direct sample into its point and the remaining independent
91:coordinates. -/
92:private def directLdSpacePointEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
93:    DirectLdSpace D ≃
94:      (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ×
95:        (Fin D.m × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) where
96:  toFun sample := (sample.point, sample.index, sample.direction)
97:  invFun sample := ⟨sample.1, sample.2.1, sample.2.2⟩
98:  left_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
99:  right_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
100:
101:/-- Decompose a direct sample into its stored index and the remaining
102:independent coordinates. -/
103:def directLdSpaceIndexEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
104:    DirectLdSpace D ≃
105:      Fin D.m ×
106:        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ×
107:          (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) where
108:  toFun sample := (sample.index, sample.point, sample.direction)
109:  invFun sample := ⟨sample.2.1, sample.1, sample.2.2⟩
110:  left_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
111:  right_inv sample := by cases sample; rfl
112:
113:/-- Compatibility name for the index-first direct-sample decomposition. -/
114:abbrev directLdSpaceIndexSplitEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
115:    DirectLdSpace D ≃
116:      Fin D.m × ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
117:  directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D
118:
119:/-- Zero the coordinates preceding the directly sampled prefix index. -/
120:def directPrefixProjection {D : DirectLdParams} (i : Fin D.m)
121:    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
122:  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
123:
124:/-- Canonical line descriptions whose coordinate index is stored directly.
125:Coordinates are numbered from zero, so `index = i` represents coordinate
126:`i + 1` in the paper. -/
127:inductive DirectLineDesc (D : DirectLdParams) where
128:  | axis (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)
129:      (baseFixed : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection index) base = base)
130:  | diagonal (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)
131:      (direction : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)
132:      (baseFixed : lineRepMap direction base = base)
133:      (prefixZero : ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < index.val → direction j = 0)
134:  deriving DecidableEq
135:
136:/-- The kind of a directly indexed line. -/
137:def DirectLineDesc.kind {D : DirectLdParams} : DirectLineDesc D → LineKind
138:  | .axis _ _ _ => .axis
139:  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => .diagonal
140:
141:/-- The coordinate index stored in a directly indexed line. -/
142:def DirectLineDesc.index {D : DirectLdParams} : DirectLineDesc D → Fin D.m
143:  | .axis _ index _ => index
144:  | .diagonal _ index _ _ _ => index
145:
146:/-- The canonical base point of a directly indexed line. -/
147:def DirectLineDesc.base {D : DirectLdParams} :
148:    DirectLineDesc D → Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D
149:  | .axis base _ _ => base
150:  | .diagonal base _ _ _ _ => base
151:
152:/-- The geometric direction of a directly indexed line. -/
153:def DirectLineDesc.direction {D : DirectLdParams} (line : DirectLineDesc D) :
154:    Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=
155:  match line with
156:  | .axis _ index _ => coordinateDirection index
157:  | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction
158:
159:/-- The base of a directly indexed description is fixed by its geometric
160:direction. -/
161:theorem DirectLineDesc.base_fixed {D : DirectLdParams} (line : DirectLineDesc D) :
162:    lineRepMap line.direction line.base = line.base := by
163:  cases line with
164:  | axis base index baseFixed => exact baseFixed
165:  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact baseFixed
166:
167:/-- Every directly indexed diagonal description retains its prefix-zero
168:invariant. -/
169:theorem DirectLineDesc.diagonal_prefix_zero {D : DirectLdParams}
170:    (line : DirectLineDesc D) (hline : line.kind = .diagonal) :
171:    ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < line.index.val → line.direction j = 0 := by
172:  cases line with
173:  | axis base index baseFixed => simp [DirectLineDesc.kind] at hline
174:  | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact prefixZero
175:
176:/-- The point set represented by a directly indexed line. -/
177:noncomputable def DirectLineDesc.pointSet {D : DirectLdParams}
178:    (line : DirectLineDesc D) : Set (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :=
179:  linePoints line.base line.direction
180:
181:/-- Turn a direct sample into its canonical axis-line description. -/
182:noncomputable def directALineDescOf (D : DirectLdParams)
183:    (sample : DirectLdSpace D) : DirectLineDesc D :=
184:  let direction := coordinateDirection sample.index
185:  let base := lineRepMap direction sample.point
186:  .axis base sample.index (lineRepMap_apply_self direction sample.point)
187:
188:/-- Turn a direct sample into its canonical diagonal-line description. -/
189:noncomputable def directDLineDescOf (D : DirectLdParams)
190:    (sample : DirectLdSpace D) : DirectLineDesc D :=
191:  let direction := directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction
192:  let base := lineRepMap direction sample.point
193:  .diagonal base sample.index direction
194:    (lineRepMap_apply_self direction sample.point) (by
195:      intro j hj
196:      change directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction j = 0
197:      rw [directPrefixProjection, if_pos hj])
198:
199:/-- The axis-line/point law with a directly sampled coordinate index. -/
200:noncomputable def directALinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
201:    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
202:  (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)).map fun sample =>
203:    (directALineDescOf D sample, sample.point)
204:
205:/-- The diagonal-line/point law with a directly sampled prefix index. -/
206:noncomputable def directDLinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
207:    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
208:  (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)).map fun sample =>
209:    (directDLineDescOf D sample, sample.point)
210:
211:/-- The equal mixture of the directly indexed axis and diagonal line-point
212:laws.  This is the replacement for the otherwise undefined extended-dimension
213:instance used at paper
214:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1116`. -/
215:noncomputable def directLinePointDist (D : DirectLdParams) :
216:    Distribution (DirectLineDesc D × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
217:  Distribution.mix (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
218:    (directALinePointDist D) (directDLinePointDist D)
219:
220:/-- The directly indexed axis-line/point law is probabilistic. -/
221:theorem directALinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
222:    (directALinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
223:  exact (uniformDistribution_isProbability (DirectLdSpace D)).map _
224:
225:/-- The directly indexed diagonal-line/point law is probabilistic. -/
226:theorem directDLinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
227:    (directDLinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
228:  exact (uniformDistribution_isProbability (DirectLdSpace D)).map _
229:
230:/-- The directly indexed line-point mixture is probabilistic. -/
231:theorem directLinePointDist_isProbability (D : DirectLdParams) :
232:    (directLinePointDist D).IsProbability := by
233:  exact Distribution.mix_isProbability _ _ _
234:    (directALinePointDist_isProbability D) (directDLinePointDist_isProbability D)
235:    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
236:
237:/-- The point and stored-index marginals of the direct axis-line law are
238:uniform.  This is a direct-index analogue of `lem:alnf`, required by
239:the repair described in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`;
240:the source distribution is at
241:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-257`.
242:-/
243:theorem directALinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
244:    (directALinePointDist D).map Prod.snd =
245:        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ∧
246:      (directALinePointDist D).map (fun sample => sample.1.index) =
247:        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m) := by
248:  constructor
249:  · unfold directALinePointDist
250:    rw [Distribution.map_map]
251:    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
252:      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
253:        (e := directLdSpacePointEquiv D)
254:        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.point) (by intro; rfl))
255:  · unfold directALinePointDist
256:    rw [Distribution.map_map]
257:    simpa [Function.comp_def, directALineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.index] using
258:      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
259:        (e := directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D)
260:        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.index) (by intro; rfl))
261:
262:/-- Every sampled direct axis line contains its paired point.  This is the
263:Direct-index incidence obligation corresponding to `lem:alnf` and
264:the repair in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
265:theorem directALinePointDist_mem_line (D : DirectLdParams) :
266:    ∀ sample ∈ (directALinePointDist D).support,
267:      sample.2 ∈ sample.1.pointSet := by
268:  intro sample hsample
269:  rw [directALinePointDist, Distribution.map_support,
270:    uniformDistribution_support] at hsample
271:  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hsample with ⟨source, _, rfl⟩
272:  simpa [directALineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.pointSet,
273:    DirectLineDesc.base, DirectLineDesc.direction] using
274:    (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap
275:      (coordinateDirection source.index) source.point)
276:
277:/-- The point and stored-index marginals of the direct diagonal-line law are
278:uniform.  This is the direct-index analogue of `lem:dlnf`, paper
279:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-272`,
280:and is a named obligation in the dimension-divisibility repair. -/
281:theorem directDLinePointDist_point_index_marginal_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
282:    (directDLinePointDist D).map Prod.snd =
283:        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ∧
284:      (directDLinePointDist D).map (fun sample => sample.1.index) =
285:        uniformDistribution (Fin D.m) := by
286:  constructor
287:  · unfold directDLinePointDist
288:    rw [Distribution.map_map]
289:    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
290:      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
291:        (e := directLdSpacePointEquiv D)
292:        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.point) (by intro; rfl))
293:  · unfold directDLinePointDist
294:    rw [Distribution.map_map]
295:    simpa [Function.comp_def, directDLineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.index] using
296:      (uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
297:        (e := directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D)
298:        (f := fun sample : DirectLdSpace D => sample.index) (by intro; rfl))
299:
300:/-- Every sampled direct diagonal line contains its paired point.  This is the
301:Direct-index incidence obligation corresponding to `lem:dlnf`. -/
302:theorem directDLinePointDist_mem_line (D : DirectLdParams) :
303:    ∀ sample ∈ (directDLinePointDist D).support,
304:      sample.2 ∈ sample.1.pointSet := by
305:  intro sample hsample
306:  rw [directDLinePointDist, Distribution.map_support,
307:    uniformDistribution_support] at hsample
308:  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hsample with ⟨source, _, rfl⟩
309:  simpa [directDLineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.pointSet,
310:    DirectLineDesc.base, DirectLineDesc.direction] using
311:    (mem_linePoints_lineRepMap
312:      (directPrefixProjection source.index source.direction) source.point)
313:
314:/-- A sampled direct diagonal direction vanishes below its stored prefix
315:index.  This is the direct counterpart of the third conclusion of
316:`lem:dlnf`, paper
317:`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:261-272`.
318:-/
319:theorem directDLinePointDist_prefix_zero (D : DirectLdParams) :
320:    ∀ sample ∈ (directDLinePointDist D).support,
321:      ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < sample.1.index.val →
322:        sample.1.direction j = 0 := by
323:  intro sample hsample j hj
324:  rw [directDLinePointDist, Distribution.map_support,
325:    uniformDistribution_support] at hsample
326:  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hsample with ⟨source, _, rfl⟩
327:  exact DirectLineDesc.diagonal_prefix_zero
328:    (directDLineDescOf D source) (by
329:      simp [directDLineDescOf, DirectLineDesc.kind]) j hj
330:
331:end
332:
333:end MIPStarRE.QPBT

# Correlated-ancilla consistency compression

This module contains the correlated-state identities and the two valid
seed-fiber consistency-defect compression results.

## References

- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:393-458`
- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:180-202`
- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
-/

/-! ## Seed-fiber identities -/

/-- Reconstructing a seed-indexed point question in any residue block gives
the original point question. -/
@[simp] theorem seededLdQuestion_directLdPointQuestionOf
    (L : LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)
    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    seededLdQuestion L
        (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u) residue =
      ldPointQuestionOf L u :=
  rfl

/-- The direct point-answer readout agrees with the seed-indexed readout: the
answer equivalence preserves point answers. -/
@[simp] theorem ldPointValuesOrZero_ldDirectAnswerEquiv_symm
    (L : LdParams) (a : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
    ldPointValuesOrZero L ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a) =
      directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams a := by
  cases a <;> rfl

private theorem seedFiberPointMeasurement
    (L : LdParams) {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    (M : LdQuestion L →
      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (LdAnswer L) iota)
    (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
    (blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
        matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
          (M (seededLdQuestion L
            (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u) residue))).postprocess
        (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams) =
      blockDiagonalMeasurement fun _ =>
        (M (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess (ldPointValuesOrZero L) := by
  rw [blockDiagonalMeasurement_postprocess]
  apply congrArg blockDiagonalMeasurement
  funext residue
  rw [matrixMeasurementTransport_postprocess,
    seededLdQuestion_directLdPointQuestionOf]
  congr 1
  funext a
  cases a <;> rfl

/-- The point POVM of the correlated-residue extension of the strategy is the
block-diagonal amplification of Alice's original seed-indexed point POVM. -/
theorem ldStrategyToDirect_pointMeasurementA
    (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
    (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
    (((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A
        (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u)).postprocess
      (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams)) =
      blockDiagonalMeasurement fun _ =>
        (S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess (ldPointValuesOrZero L) := by
  change (blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
      matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L
          (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u) residue))).postprocess
      (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams) = _
  exact seedFiberPointMeasurement L S.A u

/-- The point POVM of the correlated-residue extension of the strategy is the
block-diagonal amplification of Bob's original seed-indexed point POVM. -/
theorem ldStrategyToDirect_pointMeasurementB
    (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
    (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) :
    (((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B
        (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u)).postprocess
      (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams)) =
      blockDiagonalMeasurement fun _ =>
        (S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess (ldPointValuesOrZero L) := by
  change (blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
      matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L
          (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u) residue))).postprocess
      (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams) = _
  exact seedFiberPointMeasurement L S.B u

private theorem correlatedState_compress_left
    {iotaA iotaB block : Type*}
    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]
    [Fintype iotaB] [DecidableEq iotaB]
    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block] [Nonempty block]
    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((iotaA × block) × (iotaB × block)))
    (hphi : ∀ i j r s, phi ((i, r), (j, s)) =
      if r = s then
        psi (i, j) * (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹
      else 0)
    (A : Op (iotaA × block)) (B : Op iotaB) :
    DistanceCalculus.stateQForm phi
        (heteroKron A (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => B)) =
      DistanceCalculus.stateQForm psi
        (heteroKron (averageDiagonalBlock A) B) := by
  classical
  unfold DistanceCalculus.stateQForm
  apply congrArg Complex.re
  unfold applyOperatorToState heteroKron Matrix.kronecker averageDiagonalBlock
  simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
  simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, dotProduct,
    Matrix.mulVec]
  simp_rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  suffices h :
      (∑ i : iotaA, ∑ r : block, ∑ j : iotaB,
        ∑ i' : iotaA, ∑ j' : iotaB,
          (starRingEnd ℂ)
              (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
              (B j j' * (A (i, r) (i', r) *
                ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
                  psi (i', j'))))) =
        ∑ i : iotaA, ∑ j : iotaB, ∑ i' : iotaA,
          ∑ j' : iotaB, ∑ r : block,
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
              (psi (i', j') * (B j j' *
                ((Fintype.card block : ℂ)⁻¹ * A (i, r) (i', r)))) by
    simpa [hphi, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
      apply_ite, map_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true, map_mul, Matrix.submatrix,
      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm] using h
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro i
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro j
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro i'
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro j'
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro r
  ring_nf
  rw [inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_conj (Fintype.card block)]
  ring

    [Fintype iotaA] [DecidableEq iotaA]

    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ (iotaA × iotaB))
    (phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ((iotaA × block) × (iotaB × block)))
    (hphi : ∀ i j r s, phi ((i, r), (j, s)) =

        (heteroKron (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => A) B) =

  classical

  simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]

    Matrix.mulVec]
  simp_rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  suffices h :
      (∑ i : iotaA, ∑ r : block, ∑ j : iotaB,
        ∑ i' : iotaA, ∑ j' : iotaB,
          (starRingEnd ℂ)
              (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
              (A i i' * (B (j, r) (j', r) *
                ((Real.sqrt (Fintype.card block : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *

        ∑ i : iotaA, ∑ j : iotaB, ∑ i' : iotaA,
          ∑ j' : iotaB, ∑ r : block,
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (psi (i, j)) *
              (psi (i', j') * (A i i' *
                ((Fintype.card block : ℂ)⁻¹ * B (j, r) (j', r)))) by
    simpa [hphi, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply,
      apply_ite, map_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true, map_mul, Matrix.submatrix,
      Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm] using h
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro i
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro j
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr

intro i'
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro j'
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro r

/-- Compressing Alice's ancillary register preserves every correlation against
an operator on Bob's original carrier. -/
theorem seedFiberLiftedState_compress_left
    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
    (A : Op (S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m))) (B : Op S.ιB) :
    DistanceCalculus.stateQForm (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
        (heteroKron A (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => B)) =
      DistanceCalculus.stateQForm S.ψ
        (heteroKron (averageDiagonalBlock A) B) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  apply correlatedState_compress_left S.ψ (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
  intro i j r s
  exact seedFiberLiftedState_apply S L i j r s

/-- Compressing Bob's ancillary register preserves every correlation against
an operator on Alice's original carrier. -/
theorem seedFiberLiftedState_compress_right
    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
    (A : Op S.ιA) (B : Op (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
    DistanceCalculus.stateQForm (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
        (heteroKron (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => A) B) =
      DistanceCalculus.stateQForm S.ψ
        (heteroKron A (averageDiagonalBlock B)) := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  apply correlatedState_compress_right S.ψ (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
  intro i j r s
  exact seedFiberLiftedState_apply S L i j r s

/-- Compressing an arbitrary Alice family preserves its defect against a Bob
family that is constant on the correlated residue register. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_seedFiber_compress_left
    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
    {X alpha : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
    (mu : Distribution X)
    (A : X → alpha → Op (S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)))
    (B : X → alpha → Op S.ιB) :
    consistencyDefect mu
        (fun x a => heteroKron (A x a) 1)
        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => B x a))
        (seedFiberLiftedState S L) =
      consistencyDefect mu
        (fun x a => heteroKron (averageDiagonalBlock (A x a)) 1)
        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (B x a)) S.ψ := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  unfold consistencyDefect avgOver
  simp_rw [DistanceCalculus.consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
    DistanceCalculus.placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  congr 1
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro a
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro b
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · simp [hab]
  · simp only [if_neg hab]
    exact seedFiberLiftedState_compress_left S L (A x a) (B x b)

/-- Compressing an arbitrary Bob family preserves its defect against an Alice
family that is constant on the correlated residue register. -/
theorem consistencyDefect_seedFiber_compress_right
    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
    {X alpha : Type*} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
    (mu : Distribution X) (A : X → alpha → Op S.ιA)
    (B : X → alpha → Op (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
    consistencyDefect mu
        (fun x a => heteroKron (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun _ => A x a) 1)
        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (B x a)) (seedFiberLiftedState S L) =
      consistencyDefect mu
        (fun x a => heteroKron (A x a) 1)
        (fun x a => heteroKron 1 (averageDiagonalBlock (B x a))) S.ψ := by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
  unfold consistencyDefect avgOver
  simp_rw [DistanceCalculus.consistency_term_eq_stateQForm,
    DistanceCalculus.placed_product_stateQForm_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  congr 1
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro a
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro b
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · simp [hab]
  · simp only [if_neg hab]
    exact seedFiberLiftedState_compress_right S L (A x a) (B x b)

/-- The point-on-Alice/global-on-Bob defect of the correlated-residue extension
of the strategy is exactly the defect of the compressed polynomial tuple on the
original seed-indexed strategy. -/
theorem ldStrategyToDirect_pointPolynomial_compression
    (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
    (GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
      (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
        (fun u outcome =>
          heteroKron
            ((((ldStrategyToDirect L S).A
              (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u)).postprocess
                (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams)).effect outcome) 1)
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
          ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
        (ldStrategyToDirect L S).ψ =
      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron
          (((S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
            (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome) 1)
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
          (((seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple L GB).postprocess
            (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome)) S.ψ := by
  rw [show (ldStrategyToDirect L S).ψ = seedFiberLiftedState S L by rfl]
  simp only [ldStrategyToDirect_pointMeasurementA,
    blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect,
    seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple_evaluation,
    seedFiberCompressMeasurement_effect]
  convert consistencyDefect_seedFiber_compress_right S L
    (X := Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (alpha := Fin L.k → ScalarQ L)
    (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
    (fun u outcome =>
      ((S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
        (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome)
    (fun u outcome =>
      (GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) using 1
  apply consistencyDefect_congr <;> intros <;> rfl

/-- The global-on-Alice/point-on-Bob defect of the correlated-residue extension
of the strategy is exactly the defect of the compressed polynomial tuple on the
original seed-indexed strategy. -/
theorem ldStrategyToDirect_polynomialPoint_compression
    (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
    (GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple L.toDirectLdParams
      (S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :
    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron
          ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
        (fun u outcome =>
          heteroKron 1
            ((((ldStrategyToDirect L S).B
              (directLdPointQuestionOf L.toDirectLdParams u)).postprocess
                (directLdPointValuesOrZero L.toDirectLdParams)).effect outcome))
        (ldStrategyToDirect L S).ψ =
      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron
          (((seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple L GA).postprocess
            (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
        (fun u outcome => heteroKron 1
          (((S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
            (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome)) S.ψ := by
  rw [show (ldStrategyToDirect L S).ψ = seedFiberLiftedState S L by rfl]
  simp only [ldStrategyToDirect_pointMeasurementB,
    blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect,
    seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple_evaluation,
    seedFiberCompressMeasurement_effect]
  convert consistencyDefect_seedFiber_compress_left S L
    (X := Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (alpha := Fin L.k → ScalarQ L)
    (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
    (fun u outcome =>
      (GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome)
    (fun u outcome =>
      ((S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
        (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome) using 1
  all_goals
    apply consistencyDefect_congr <;> intros <;> rfl

end
